name: week
title: Coupon operations this week
subtitle: Local redemption ledger. Reconcile with checkout records.

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by campaign,reason

sections.title: Campaign budgets
sections.sql: select name,currency,status,budget_cents,used_cents,remaining_cents from campaign_budget order by name

sections.title: Codes
sections.sql: select code,expires_at,redemption_limit,imported_count,local_uses,remaining_uses from coupon_usage order by expires_at

sections.title: Record findings
sections.note: Evidence checks support human review; they do not certify lawful advertising.
sections.sql: select name,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by name,rule
